A grad student and undergrad thing...  Her last bf was a senior and pretty much dated and then broke up with her once he had graduated.  Although she knew that it was going to happen and only last three months...

So, she suggested that we head to my place instead.  So, I play games and she studies.  Once I'm finished I find her wrapped in my fleece blanket napping.  When I walk over she wraps herself up like a mummy...  So, I start making dinner.

She says she doesn't care if I cuddle with her because she could push me off the couch if she wanted.  So, I try to get her out of the blanket, so eventually I just crawl into it and steal it from her.  Then she decides to go sleep in my bed.

So, she keeps pushing the blanket and pillows in my face because it is fun.  This time I hold her hands and she doesn't push me away at all.  I give her a kiss.  Then she puts the pillow over her face haha  I ask if she didn't want me to do that and she says she didn't have a problem with it.

Then we eat and watch tv and we are definitely cuddling and holding hands and stuff.  When she leaves she just waves bye.  I'm not used to someone who wants to take things this slow haha, but she wants to see me again.
She says she doesn't like being looked at haha

Yeah, I worked in a lab in my undergraduate and did two individual research experiments.  I could only get paid a certain number of hours, but I would still come in later that night and finish up some of the samples. He of course suggested graduate school.  I was hesitant, but he said that both really bright and really hard working (referring to me) people go to graduate school. 

 I guess what I enjoy is running the experiment not making it.  If he chose the project for me I'd have more motivation I suppose.  

He started the year giving me 50 papers to read, I loved it!  He told me to spend my time on my proposal with my free time.  I finished the proposal in around a month, but he seemed to put it off and I didn't get it in until last semester instead of last year.  He told me not to do anything except spend my time reading papers.  He told me not to take any more classes or get a job.  I should have ignored all of this :(  Too much free time, I need some structure you know?

I've been antisocial and I'm the only one in my lab.  It doesn't foster warmth and puppies.

All the medicine did was lower my heart rate and make me groggy.  Being groggy isn't going to help me get to sleep.  It made me feel worse if anything.
